problemStatement.plain: Construct a Lean proof that L'Hopital's rule can fail: f(x)=x+sin x, g(x)=x gives lim f/g = 1 but lim f'/g' = lim(1+cos x) does not exist. Extension of LHopital.lean (Wiedijk #65).
whyMatters: Clarifies the necessity of L'Hopital's hypotheses
Extends Wiedijk #65 gallery entry with tightness result

proven: LHopital.lean: rule holds when lim f'/g' exists
LHopitalOQ02.lean and LHopitalOQ03.lean extend the rule
open: Formalize: lim(1+cos x) as x→∞ does not exist
